text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, zoledronic acid supply is limited. Corvale East holds 36 units with 11 days of supply at 3.3 units daily. Corvale General holds 89 units with 32 days of supply at 2.8 units daily. The product label identifies Gland Pharma Limited as the manufacturer for NDC 68083014201. This drug is not on the FDA shortage list.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection records for Gland Pharma Limited (FEI 3002647489) show a series of Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI) classifications from 2012 through 2024. The most recent inspection ended on 2024-07-25 and was classified VAI, with the classification known to FDA on 2025-01-15.

Our position: Current inventory covers immediate needs at both sites. No shortage is declared by FDA. Alternative manufacturers are available but their labels do not identify production plants, limiting supply chain verification.

Recommended actions:
1. Continue purchasing from current Gland Pharma Limited supply — buyer approves.
2. Evaluate Accord Healthcare Inc., AuroMedics Pharma LLC, Avenacy Inc., BPI Labs LLC, and BluePoint Laboratories as backup sources — buyer approves vendor qualification; P&T committee approves formulary addition if needed.
3. Request plant identification from alternative manufacturers before committing volume — buyer approves inquiry.
4. Monitor daily usage and update days-of-supply weekly — buyer approves reporting.

Not recommended: Switching primary supply away from Gland Pharma Limited based solely on VAI history without a declared shortage or supply disruption.
